messages.subject: Shinnyapps IP Address whitelist
parts:
Hi All, 

We are using Shinnyapps with an RDS database hosted in the AWS cloud, which works by whitelisting IP addresses to external servers. Is there an IP address/range that shinnyapps uses so we can whitelist and give access to our database to fetch data?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Shinnyapps IP Address whitelist
parts:
Ivan,

We had forgot to reallocate an elastic IP to one of our app servers, which I went ahead and fixed. However we're now recommending that users use our EC2 security group identifier rather then hardcoded IP addresses. Instructions to allow access to your RDS instances from our security group:

You’ll need to add RStudio’s EC2 Security Group to the database:
1. Log into your Amazon AWS console
2. Click on the RDS Dashboard under the Database section
3. Navigate to the Security Groups tab
4. Select the database you want to allow access to
5. At the very bottom there is a dropdown for Connection Type, select EC2 Security Group
6. Select Another Account
7. Enter the account ID and Security Group name for shinyapps.io:
AWS Account ID: 954555569365
EC2 Security Group Name: production-agents
8. Authorize!
